q: How do we report HVO renewable diesel in Scope 1?
title: Reporting HVO renewable diesel
short: HVO is made from vegetable oils or waste fats, so the CO2 from burning it is biogenic: report it separately, outside the scope totals. Methane and nitrous oxide from combustion still count in Scope 1. Its production and transport emissions go in Scope 3 Category 3. Keep the supplier certificate showing the feedstock.
audience: Fleet and genset operators trialling renewable diesel

ul: Litres of HVO and of fossil diesel separately.
The blend share if bought as a blend.

p: For a blend, only the fossil share counts as Scope 1 CO2. The renewable share is biogenic.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices and electricity bills and applies IPCC 2006 factors and the CEA grid factor (0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25), so you can compare Scope 1 and 2 before and after a change from the documents themselves.
